newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek stocks trim early losses, close lower.
newsitem.headline: Greek stocks trim early losses, close lower.

text.p: Greek shares bounced off the session's low at 1,256.82, trimming early losses to settle 0.78 percent lower in moderate trading volume of 12.5 billion drachmas. Construction led the retreat dropping 1.81 percent.

"The market is cooling off after its rally and the recent volatility, keeping an eye on the Albanian crisis and the macroeconomic front. Selling pressure is on the light side and buying is subdued. Stocks are taking a breather," said a floor trader.
He pointed out that the market could easily resume its climb but was in need of news to drive another leg of this year's uptrend.
"Construction shares are still struggling but 1,200 points will prove to be a strong support. The way things stand, I think the market has found an interim equilibrium," the trader said.
The Athens general share index ended 0.78 percent or 9.98 points lower at 1268.14 points from Thursday's 1278.12 after opening at 1268.65.
